'''''Cage Warriors 213: London''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event promoted by [[Cage Warriors]] that took place on November 14, 2026, in [[London]], England.

===Background===
A [[Cage Warriors#Cage Warriors Featherweight Championship|Cage Warriors Featherweight Championship]] bout between current champion Nik Bagley and Bruno Souza headlined the event.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-10-09 |title=Nik Bagley To Defend 145LBS Title Against Bruno Souza 
|url=https://cagewarriors.com/nik-bagley-to-defend-145lbs-title-against-bruno-souza/ |access-date=2026-10-23 |website=Cage Warriors |language=en}}</ref>
